title: Subtree Inversion Sum II
summary: A tree rooted at zero has node values. Select nodes to invert their entire descendant subtrees by multiplying values by -1. Every pair of selected nodes must be at tree distance at least k, including nodes in different branches. Overlapping inversions compose. Return the maximum final total value.
